column1: # The files of the regression suite that run before a file, on both sides, to give it the tables and objects it expects: the
# regression harness (fork issue #119) runs each file on a fresh database, while pg_regress runs them all in one. The entries
# beside test_setup are the dependencies that the comments of parallel_schedule name. The statements of these files are not
# judged there; each file is judged when it is run itself.
# Columns, tab separated: the file ("*" for every other file), and the files to run before it, separated by commas ("-" for none)
